assertion_audit.fails_if: The persisted aggregate is not indexed, a fixture terminal has its own run file, or an absent id is wrongly reported present; these establish positive and negative lookup controls.
The real Station.tick boundary fails to visit 50 fixture identities, returns a missing identity or rebuilds twice after the intervening ledger write; removing per-pass validation makes line 138 fail.

Any persisted identity is lost, fewer than 49 later reads execute, nested scopes reset validation or later reads issue BEGIN/schema/DML; restoring stale-per-lookup refresh changes observed rebuild counts and SQL traces.

A current lookup requests the existing connection helper without read_only=True, loses the present identity or bypasses/repeats the helper; restoring the original writer-opening _ensure trips line 193.

The child never enters its rebuild, a lookup falls back to historical ledger reads, known present/absent membership is wrong, reads wait for the child or exceed one second, or child rebuilding fails; restoring blocking rebuild acquisition violates timing/liveness and may hit the explicit history refusal.

Known present membership fails, stale reads rebuild inside the first scope or validation leaks across outer scopes and prevents the next rebuild; removing reuse fails line 260, while retaining the cache beyond the outer scope fails line 263.
Admission/review does not reach its patched first runtime hook, a known indexed id is lost or removing either operational_read decorator makes the two reads rebuild twice.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares an implementation-supplied expected value with the same input echoed back: membership is grounded in the persisted aggregate and absent-id control, counts observe ledger.load calls, SQL is independently traced, and concurrency uses a separate process and monotonic time.

gate_evidence.reproduction_quote: one tick rebuilt 2 times; lookup waited 4.041s behind the rebuild
